blocks.text: Manila kicks off the Asia tour! MANILA | 24 FEBRUARY 2027 (WEDNESDAY), 8PM | SMART ARANETA COLISEUM “The Hayley Williams Show” has officially announced its highly anticipated expansion across Asia! After the extensive North America, U.K. and Europe leg, Asian fans are finally next. This expansion comes on the heels of sold-out shows at iconic venues across the world, including the Hollywood Bowl in Los Angeles, Espaço Unimed in São Paulo and more. The Asia leg will kick off in February 2027 in Manila at the Smart Araneta Coliseum. This is followed by stops in Singapore at Star Theatre, Seoul at Yes24 Live Hall, and Tokyo at the Toyosu PIT.
